interface.longDescription: Fly.io Bridge by Mohammed Mansour for Qumi Teknolojis (trading name of QROO Inc.). Provides a direct connection to Fly.io's official OAuth-protected remote MCP server at https://mcp.fly.io, plus an independent agent-local MCP runtime exposing flyctl installation, live command discovery, health checks, authenticated read operations and individually approved state-changing CLI commands. No organization, app, account, path or credentials are bundled. Each operator authorizes Fly MCP through the official browser OAuth flow; CLI authentication uses Fly's own login, a platform-injected FLY_API_TOKEN, or a local passphrase-encrypted vault unlocked only at execution. Includes official fly skills/setup agent guidance and controlled local installation for Codex, Claude Code and other MCP clients. Separate official MCP and CLI surfaces avoid hardcoding upstream tools. Fly MCP capabilities are governed by the actual connected server and OAuth grants. Secure per-user credential questions use URL-mode MCP elicitation or a localhost browser fallback on Windows, Linux and macOS. The browser encrypts answers with RSA-OAEP/AES-GCM before local submission; the bridge stores AES-256-GCM ciphertext outside Git. No plaintext secret is collected through agent chat. Remote/cloud agents require an approved HTTPS credential portal or platform secret manager; URL question styling is controlled by the client.
